selected_evidence.summary: modprobe resolved usb-storage to /bin/false; an explicit load attempt exited 1 and the module remained absent.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: The initramfs was rebuilt; after reboot the policy remained present, explicit loading failed, and usb_storage remained absent.

Baseline boot ID was 4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 74bab2c7-108d-4209-bee0-b98b16ca6aad; system state and root filesystem recovered, and the blacklist remained effective.
